cues.evidence: The corridor narrowed, the ceiling dropping until Torin had to tilt his head back to avoid the rough-hewn flagstones. The air grew heavier, thick with the scent of damp rot and something sharper, like rusted iron.

cues.evidence: The fire was dying down, the embers glowing red in the darkness. The air was still cold, still damp.
